fileWork.detail: New Markdown file containing a single line naming this issue, e.g. `# Legion Stage 3 durable workflow proof: S392497156-1`. This is the only repository file the root issue changes. Do not touch smoke/ files owned by the child S392497156-4.

notes: This is a Stage-3 smoke proof. Plan and spec live in Dispatch and .legion/plan.json only; no plan/spec markdown is committed to the repository. The only planner commit is `plan: record handoff`.
ordering: Implementer: create smoke/S392497156-1.md (single line naming S392497156-1); commit; push issue branch legion/S392497156-1; open PR with body containing `Dispatch: S392497156-1`.

Implementer proof: PR diff shows exactly the one added file; ci.yml `check` job green at head SHA. Negative control: an empty or misnamed file / a second changed file would fail the acceptance (exactly-one-file rule).
A review may ask for one additional line appended to smoke/S392497156-1.md; that is in scope and lands as a new commit on the same branch.
Tester: verify the implementer's proof (re-run pr diff + status check at head) and record own E2E line.

implement: none: legion-smoke is a docs-only markdown sandbox with no build/test tooling; the change is one new Markdown file, so no repository implementation skill applies. ce-simplify-code does not run on a docs-only diff.
review: none: docs-only one-line Markdown change; no repository review skill applies and the thermonuclear pair is skipped on a docs-only PR per legion-worker.
test: none: no repository test harness exists (ci.yml is a trivial sleep-and-exit check); the criterion is proven on the GitHub PR surface (diff + green CI) via legion gh, not a test skill.

risks: Acceptance 1 requires exactly one new file: adding, renaming, or modifying any other file (README.md, other smoke/ files) fails it. Keep the diff to smoke/S392497156-1.md only.
File-name collision with the child S392497156-4: each issue writes a distinctly named file, so no conflict; do not touch the child's file.
CI is push/pull_request triggered and green by construction (exit 0); a red check would only occur from workflow/infra failure — re-run the single failed job, never push to refresh.
summary: Plan for the one-file smoke change: root issue S392497156-1 adds exactly one new Markdown file smoke/S392497156-1.md holding a single line naming this issue. Proven on the real surface (GitHub PR diff + green ci.yml check). The adopted child S392497156-4 delivers its own separate file and is owned by its sub-architect; integration verified on current main after both merge.
